tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Treasury.

tree.heading: Board
tree.text: The term “Board” means the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This subchapter, referred to in text, was in the original “this subtitle”, meaning subtitle A (§§ 3001–3006) of title III of Pub. L. 100–418, Aug. 23, 1988, 102 Stat. 1372, which is classified principally to this subchapter. For complete classification of subtitle A to the Code, see Tables.
